source: echarts 6.1.0 (echarts.js, two read-only hooks round the avoidOverlap call), node SSR, SVG renderer
notes: pies[].items[] is pieLabelLayout's list (outer and centre labels, data order); entry before avoidOverlap, exit after it.
exit.line is before limitTurnAngle / limitSurfaceAngle (roadmap B14); labels[].guide.points is as drawn.
labels[].ignore includes LabelManager's hideOverlap (a pie's default labelLayout).
